item.title: EU funding eyes Europe’s first domestic high-purity vanadium producer

item.title: Kingsrose Mining Hit with Penikat Permit Setback, Drilling Delayed
item.description: Small cap mining hopeful Kingsrose Mining (**KRM.ASX**) has announced a setback at its Penikat project in Finland. The news has put a temporary halt to the company's winter drilling program.
